result.summary: Overall the page looks well-designed and functional. A few minor visual issues were found, mostly related to cropped/truncated content in horizontal carousels and low-contrast placeholder text.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen; its name is truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' with no visible truncation indicator like ellipsis.
issues.suggestion: Add an ellipsis for truncated restaurant names or ensure carousel cards peek with a clearer partial-card affordance.

issues.description: The category filter chips (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) are horizontally scrollable but the last chip is clipped mid-way at the right edge, which can look unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient at the edge of the scrollable chip row to indicate more content is available.

issues.description: The search placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on light gray, which is low contrast for the placeholder text.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color slightly to improve readability while keeping it distinguishable from entered text.

issues.description: The status bar shows a low-battery icon (74% with red-tinted indicator) which may distract in screenshots but is a system element, not app content.
issues.suggestion: No app-side fix needed; ensure QA screenshots are taken without battery-saver mode for accurate color rendering.
